archived.title: Phase 0 — Dockerize QP-CRM (image + compose + volumes + env secrets)
archived.description: PHASE 0 of the roadmap (first execution phase; runs in a dedicated chat). Dockerize for easy running/updating of the main instance. Steps: (1) pin requirements (pip freeze from working venv) + add gunicorn; (2) wsgi entrypoint `from main import application` + explicit init sequence (pricing_init_db, pricing_migrate_schema, offer_init_db, admin_init_db, rent_init_db) since those run only under `__main__` today; (3) Dockerfile python:3.12-slim + apt libs from run_apps.sh PKGS list (libpango-1.0-0 libpangoft2-1.0-0 libharfbuzz-subset0 libgdk-pixbuf-2.0-0 libcairo2 shared-mime-info fonts-dejavu-core) — also fixes the current libpango boot blocker on this machine; non-root user; gunicorn --workers 2 --threads 4 (debugger/reloader OFF, audit C1); switch pricing/offer/rent hardcoded secret keys to os.environ.get; (4) docker-compose.yml: volumes app_data/ + app_assets/ + static/img (logo upload writes into static/img — lost on rebuild without a volume), env-based secrets, TZ=Europe/Belgrade, healthcheck /api/v1/health, restart unless-stopped; (5) .dockerignore (venv, .git, README_Images, *.pdf, *.xlsx, main.log, scratch scripts); (6) smoke checklist: login each app, product+price, offer PDF, rent doc PDF, backup download; (7) replace run_apps.sh git-pull/pkill -f main.py update flow with image rebuild (audit M11); keep run_apps.sh for bare-metal users. HANDOVER PROTOCOL on completion: commit per step on a phase branch, tag the image, mark this card done with summary+rejected fields, write an Agent Note for the dockerization decisions — the next phase chat starts from the board.
archived.rationale: User confirmed the per-phase dedicated-chat workflow; the docker card is the entry point of the whole roadmap and must carry an explicit phase number and the handover protocol so a fresh chat with zero conversation memory can execute it from the board alone.
archived.rejected: Alpine base (musl breaks WeasyPrint), named volumes (bind mounts reuse host data, uid 1000 matches), schema creation at build time (data belongs in volumes), random token_hex secret fallbacks (invalidate sessions per restart — stable old literals kept as dev fallback), subagent-written Dockerfile (3 stall attempts — orchestrator wrote it directly).
archived.summary: PHASE 0 COMPLETE on branch phase-0-docker (git tag phase-0), image qp-crm:phase0 (382MB), stack healthy. Executed via 8 task cards (P0-T1..T8) + 9 per-step commits: pinned requirements+gunicorn 26.2.0 (61080f1); wsgi.py entrypoint replaying main.py's init sequence fork-safely (cda297d); Dockerfile python:3.12-slim + WeasyPrint libs + non-root uid 1000 + gunicorn --preload (273826d + perms fix 867ca19); compose stack with bind-mount volumes (app_data/app_assets/static/img), env_file .env, TZ=Europe/Belgrade, restart unless-stopped, /api/v1/health healthcheck (f5196da); deploy.sh rebuild-and-wait flow + DOCKER.md, run_apps.sh kept for bare metal (1bd588d); custom_libs tracked for fresh-clone builds (3592f80). Smoke checklist ALL PASS: health, 4 app logins, product+price via UI, offer PDF (SMOKE-2026-001, 386KB), rent doc PDF (44.5KB), backup download (SQLite 221KB). .env with real generated secrets on host (git-ignored, chmod 600); .env.example checked in. Dev branch untouched.

archived.title: Phase 3 — Users & user management (unified auth, roles, CSRF, hashing)
archived.description: Phase 3 of the roadmap — ran AFTER Phase 2 (single app + blueprints) so login/session/CSRF were written once against the final shape. Env-based secrets for Docker landed in Phase 0 (pricing/offer/rent hardcoded keys switched to os.environ.get there). Delivered: users table (id, username, password_hash, role, is_active, modules_set, created_at, last_login); single unified login on the top-level app (one qp_session cookie, path=/, 8h sliding expiry); per-app password gates replaced by shared require_role('admin'/'staff') + per-user app access via require_module and the user_modules table (pricing/offer/rent/sale checkboxes per staff user in Admin -> Users; admins bypass); werkzeug hashed passwords with transparent rehash-on-login from legacy plaintext (no plaintext at rest — scrub_legacy_password_keys on every boot); CSRF shield on every state-changing route incl. AJAX (settings-app pattern generalized into shared/web.py; audit C5 closed); API keys table + per-user keys with attribution (global key deprecated but working); login_audit log + in-process lockout (5 fails / 15 min per IP+username); sandboxed Jinja for DB PDF templates already closed C4 in Phase 2, template editor admin-only; Admin Users UI (create/deactivate/reset/role change, one Save per user, own-password confirmed), landing page requires login + access-filtered app menu, logout moved into Settings, header unified with Home button. Extra user-request UX work folded in (Serbian feedback cards): admin header options missing on subpages fixed via shared _nav include, /admin/rent/templates login loop fixed, logout button moved to settings, Landing Page renamed Home. Suite grew to 243+ tests; 3 golden-PDF skips outside the pinned image by design. Verified live on :5000 (admin walks all module pages, anonymous redirects to /login?next=, CSRF 400s on tokenless POSTs, /api/v1 401 without key).
archived.rationale: User's milestone 2, positioned after the Phase-2 blueprint consolidation so login/session/CSRF were written once against the final shape and before features (roles gate who may create invoices, edit stock, manage templates).
archived.rejected: Heavy auth frameworks (Flask-User/OAuth) — overkill for LAN scale; per-app user tables — would perpetuate the six-realm session split; landing auth before consolidation — double work. Forced first-login password change — retired mid-phase by user request (password changes exclusively admin-managed in Admin -> Users); default staff users kept as seeds — retired later by the 'no default users beyond admin' change (separate card/commit 4f3a2a1).
archived.summary: Phase 3 delivered and verified: unified login + roles + per-user module grants, werkzeug hashing with legacy rehash + scrub, CSRF everywhere, per-user API keys + audit, lockout, 8h sessions, Admin Users UI, landing auth gate + access-filtered menu, and the user-requested header/logout/Home fixes. Exit criteria met (single login, roles enforced per module, every POST CSRF-protected, no plaintext at rest).

archived.title: Phase 1 — Test safety net: characterization + golden-PDF tests (before any refactor)
archived.description: Prerequisite for ALL structural work: the app has zero tests, so 'clear technical debt' without this is gambling with the price engine. Build a small, high-value pytest suite: (1) characterization tests for pure business logic — recalc_totals 3-level discount cascade, apply_rounding + rounding rules, calculate_rent/pmt/generate_schedule, format_amount/format_date, rent placeholder substitution; (2) golden-file PDF tests — render one fixed offer and one fixed rent document, compare against checked-in baselines (pin fonts in the image for byte-stability), re-baselined consciously only when a change is intended; (3) Flask test-client smoke tests per module (login → main pages → 200). Runs via `docker compose run app pytest`; wire into CI if a repo host exists. Exit criteria: suite green on main; every Phase-2 refactor step must keep it green.
archived.rationale: User's plan is to break the monolith and clear tech debt before features. Refactoring an untested price/lease/discount engine silently changes money — the safety net must exist before the first structural commit, and it is what makes 'time is no object' refactoring safe instead of brave.
archived.rejected: Host-venv test runs (WeasyPrint unimportable without libpango); compose-override test service (breaks the one plain command); fixing discovered bugs (forbidden — they are Phase-2 cards now); pushing to origin (user decides).
archived.summary: DONE. Suite: 120 tests green on the UNMODIFIED app — 4 infra guards, 33 rounding, 6 recalc cascade, 22 rent math, 29 formatting+placeholders, 2 golden PDFs, 24 smoke. ONE command (documented on this card, in tests/README.md and DOCKER.md): docker compose build app && docker compose run --rm app pytest. Suite runs INSIDE the pinned image (fonts pinned, no host deps), fully isolated from the real app_data (throwaway /tmp/qp-crm-tests, guarded by tests/test_infra_isolation.py). Golden-PDF baselines for one fixed offer + one fixed rent document are checked in and byte-stable across containers (normalizer blanks PDF dates/trailer /ID only). Branch phase-1-tests (7+1 commits, per-step), image qp-crm:phase1 (phase0 = rollback), stack healthy. Characterization captured quirks AS-IS; 5 bug cards tagged bug/phase-2-candidate; zero production-code changes (test plumbing only: dev-requirements layer, .dockerignore, compose image tag, docs).

archived.title: Phase 2 — Structural refactor: single app + blueprints, single schema, service layer
archived.description: The monolith-breaking program, done incrementally with Phase-1 tests green at every step and a Docker image rebuild + smoke test per merged step. Order within the phase: (1) consolidate 6 Flask instances → 1 Flask app + blueprints, URL prefixes preserved (/pricing, /offer, /rent, /admin, /sale, /settings), one session/secret/cookie, remove DispatcherMiddleware — validate the pattern on the smallest module (sale or settings) first, then pricing/offer/rent/admin; (2) deduplicate copy-pasted helpers (md filter, format_date, get_theme, check_auth → blueprint-level hooks) into shared/; (3) single-source the DB schema — one schema module consumed by all init_db calls, delete the stale offers/offer_items duplicate in pricing/app.py, keep idempotent ALTER migrations, add UNIQUE constraints where data permits; (4) extract service layer — pricing_service (cascade+rounding), offer_service (totals+numbering), rent_service (PMT+schedule+placeholders), pdf_service (shared WeasyPrint render helper with sandboxed Jinja → fixes SSTI during the move); (5) split 1.2–1.8k-line route files into per-domain modules; (6) proper package layout (qp_crm/), delete sys.path hacks, replace vendored custom_libs/markdown with pinned pip dependency Markdown==3.10.2; (7) CI running pytest. DISCIPLINE: zero behavior changes inside this phase — same URLs, same totals, byte-comparable PDFs; improvements go to the Phase-4 backlog. Exit criteria: single app, no DispatcherMiddleware, no sys.path hacks, no vendored libs, single schema source, tests green.
archived.rationale: Phase 2's contract was structural-only: make the codebase testable and safe without changing user-visible behavior (golden PDFs byte-identical), then fix the pinned bugs deliberately with referenced re-baselines. Delivered so the user can manually test before Phase 3 (users/auth/CSRF).
archived.rejected: Big-bang rewrite: rejected from the start (see architecture-direction card). Bundle-fixing the 5 bugs during the structural stages was also rejected — zero-behavior-change discipline during 1-6 kept every green suite a real regression gate; bugs were fixed only after the structure was byte-verified. Remaining known debt deliberately deferred to Phase 3+: H10 bare-numeric input validation, L9 fresh connection per call, L11 float money -> Decimal, bracket-selection product decision.
archived.summary: All 7 structural stages shipped on branch phase-2-refactor (single app+blueprints, shared/ dedupe, single schema, service layer + sandboxed Jinja closing audit C4, per-domain route modules, qp_crm/ package with sys.path hacks deleted and Markdown==3.10.2 devendored, GH Actions CI), then all 5 phase-2-candidate BUG cards fixed with one commit + regression test each (rent pmt zero-period, rent schedule bad-date 400, offer discount normalization, pricing rounding semantics decision, sale bare-schema empty state). Exit criteria met: single app, no DispatcherMiddleware, no sys.path hacks, no vendored libs, single schema source. Suite 133 passed; image tagged qp-crm:phase2 (docker-compose.yml + DOCKER.md updated); golden PDFs byte-identical throughout stages 1-6.

archived.title: P0-T1 · Pin requirements.txt from working venv + add gunicorn
archived.description: Step 1 of the Phase-0 card. Install gunicorn into the existing venv, then `venv/bin/pip freeze` and rewrite requirements.txt with exact pins. Keep a comment noting: `markdown` is intentionally NOT a pip dep — vendored in custom_libs/ and added to sys.path at runtime (Phase 2 replaces this).
archived.rationale: Reproducible image builds require exact versions; unpinned ranges would make rebuilds drift and later break Phase-1 golden-PDF baselines for non-code reasons.
archived.rejected: constraints file + loose top-level requirements — overkill for a single-image app; one pinned file is what the Dockerfile consumes.
archived.summary: requirements.txt rewritten from venv pip freeze: 30 exact pins incl. gunicorn==26.2.0, Flask==3.1.3, weasyprint==69.0, Werkzeug==3.1.8; header documents the freeze procedure and that 'markdown' stays vendored in custom_libs (3.10.2) until Phase 2. pip check: no broken requirements. Committed as 'P0 step 1'.

archived.title: P0-T2 · wsgi.py entrypoint + explicit DB init sequence
archived.description: Step 2. Create /home/dsh/QP-CRM/wsgi.py exposing `application` and running the init sequence (pricing_init_db → pricing_migrate_schema → offer_init_db → admin_init_db → rent_init_db — exact names verified from main.py) at import, ensuring app_data dirs exist and no SQLite connection stays open across gunicorn fork.
archived.rationale: Schema init ran only under main.py's __main__ block; gunicorn never triggers it, so a fresh volume would boot with no schema. Init at wsgi import makes any WSGI server boot self-initializing and idempotent (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + guarded ALTERs).
archived.rejected: Schema creation at docker build time — data must live in volumes, created at runtime; try/except around init — silent empty-schema boots are worse than loud crashes; per-worker init without --preload — works (20s busy timeout) but --preload makes init run exactly once in the master, adopted in the Dockerfile CMD.
archived.summary: Created wsgi.py: sys.path root insert, os.makedirs for APP_DATA_DIR/IMAGE_DIR/APP_ASSETS_DIR before imports, explicit init sequence pricing_init_db → pricing_migrate_schema → offer_init_db → admin_init_db → rent_init_db (verified same order + same source modules as main.py:66-70), then 'from main import application' (DispatcherMiddleware, main.py:52-59). No try/except around init — boot fails loud. Connection audit: no module-level sqlite connections anywhere (all function-local, init paths close before return) → fork-safe. Committed as 'P0 step 2'.

archived.title: P0-T3 · Dockerfile: python:3.12-slim + WeasyPrint libs + non-root + gunicorn
archived.description: Step 3. python:3.12-slim base; apt packages from run_apps.sh PKGS (libpango-1.0-0 libpangoft2-1.0-0 libharfbuzz-subset0 libgdk-pixbuf-2.0-0 libcairo2 shared-mime-info fonts-dejavu-core) + tzdata — also fixes the host libpango boot blocker; WORKDIR /app; pip install -r requirements.txt; non-root uid/gid 1000 (matches host dsh uid for bind mounts); ENV TZ=Europe/Belgrade PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1; EXPOSE 5000; CMD gunicorn --workers 2 --threads 4 --bind 0.0.0.0:5000 wsgi:application (debugger/reloader OFF — audit C1). custom_libs/ MUST be copied (vendored markdown needed at runtime).
archived.rationale: The proven WeasyPrint lib set + slim base keeps PDF rendering working in a small image; uid 1000 matches the host owner of the compose bind mounts; --preload makes wsgi.py's init run exactly once in the master (T2 connection audit: no global conns, fork-safe).
archived.rejected: Alpine — musl breaks WeasyPrint/pango wheels; python:3.12 full — 1GB+ for nothing; root container — bind-mount permission mismatch; per-worker init without --preload — idempotent but races ALTER TABLE migrations on cold volumes.
archived.summary: Dockerfile written by orchestrator (3 subagent attempts stalled): python:3.12-slim + apt PKGS from run_apps.sh (libpango, libpangoft2, libharfbuzz-subset0, libgdk-pixbuf, libcairo2, shared-mime-info, fonts-dejavu-core) + tzdata; ENV TZ=Europe/Belgrade; requirements layer cached; COPY . . incl. custom_libs; non-root appuser uid/gid 1000 with chown on data dirs only; gunicorn --workers 2 --threads 4 --preload --bind 0.0.0.0:5000 wsgi:application, reloader OFF (audit C1). Committed as 'P0 step 3'.

archived.title: P0-T4 · Env-based secret keys in pricing/offer/rent
archived.description: Step 3 security slice. Replace hardcoded `app.secret_key = "crm_*_secret_key_change_me"` in pricing/app.py, offer/app.py, rent/app.py with `os.environ.get("PRICING_SECRET_KEY"/"OFFER_SECRET_KEY"/"RENT_SECRET_KEY", <old literal as dev fallback>)`, mirroring the existing admin/app.py pattern. settings/sale/admin are already env-aware — no change.
archived.rationale: Image-baked identical secret keys across installs violate the Phase-0 env-secrets requirement (audit); compose injects real values via .env while the old literal keeps bare-metal dev behavior unchanged.
archived.rejected: Random token_hex fallback (settings/app.py style) — would invalidate sessions on every restart; env-var-with-stable-fallback chosen instead.
archived.summary: Replaced hardcoded crm_*_secret_key_change_me in pricing/app.py, offer/app.py, rent/app.py with os.environ.get('PRICING|OFFER|RENT_SECRET_KEY', <old literal>), mirroring admin/app.py; committed as 'P0 step 3 (secrets)'.

archived.title: P0-T5 · docker-compose.yml + .dockerignore
archived.description: Steps 4+5. Compose: build ., image qp-crm:phase0, port 5000:5000, bind mounts ./app_data ./app_assets ./static/img (logo upload writes into static/img — lost on rebuild without the volume), env_file .env, TZ=Europe/Belgrade, restart unless-stopped, healthcheck on /api/v1/health via python urllib (no curl in slim). .dockerignore: venv, .git, .agents, KANBAN.json, README_Images, *.pdf, *.xlsx, *.xlsb, logs, scratch scripts (download_pdf*, measure_pdf*, test_*), app_data/, .env — but NOT custom_libs/.

archived.summary: docker-compose.yml (qp-crm:phase0, port 5000, env_file .env, TZ=Europe/Belgrade, bind mounts app_data/app_assets/static/img, restart unless-stopped, python-stdlib healthcheck on /api/v1/health with 60s start_period), .dockerignore (venv/.git/app_data/.env/scratch junk with **/ depth variants; custom_libs deliberately NOT ignored), .env.example (six secret keys + generation hint).
